mentions.name: Online memorial platform
mentions.description: An online memorial platform in China used by local governments and cemeteries for digital remembrance, delivered via a WeChat mini-app and web pages. A global web and app version is being explored for families worldwide, especially those separated by distance, and the builder is open to marketing or distribution collaborations.
mentions.problem: Families separated by distance need a way to conduct digital remembrance for loved ones.
mentions.audience: Local governments and cemeteries in China; families worldwide, especially those separated by distance
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building an online memorial product in China, currently used via a WeChat mini-app and web pages by local governments and cemeteries for digital remembrance.

I’m now exploring a global version (web + app) for families worldwide — especially those separated by distance.
